attribution: Jerry Fisher, Statue Of Liberty Bronze Model (photogrammetry of a 19th-century bronze).
localAxes: X right as seen from the front, Y up, Z towards the front. Metres.
preprocessing: Welded and registered scan. QEM simplification with fast-simplification 0.2.0 (target 3,600 faces), followed by removal of opposing face pairs and orphan vertices. Coordinates rounded to 0.1 mm.
